Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
If I play an Aura Reading at superior to increase my handsize by 2, and I
have Agaitas in play, can I draw those 2 cards from my prey library?
Thanx

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Sat, 08 Nov 2003 01:12:27 GMT, "Cartman" <federi...@libero.it>
wrote:

>If I play an Aura Reading at superior to increase my handsize by 2, and I
>have Agaitas in play, can I draw those 2 cards from my prey library?

No.

You can only replace cards that you play.
Simply drawing 2 doesn't cut it.

You can replace the AR from your prey's library though.

Carpe noctem.

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On Sat, 08 Nov 2003 01:12:27 GMT, "Cartman" <federi...@libero.it>

scrawled:

>If I play an Aura Reading at superior to increase my handsize by 2, and I
>have Agaitas in play, can I draw those 2 cards from my prey library?
>Thanx

nope. card text.

"When you play a card, you may draw its replacement from your prey's
library instead of your own. Put the card drawn face-up in front of
you. It is still considered to be in your hand, to be played or
discarded as normal"

The two cards you're drawing when your hand size is increased are not
'replacing' anything.

The Aura Reading itself you can replace from your prey's library.

BUT, an extra question:

Can you put cards draw by Agaitas's ability in a storage annex, and if
so do they go face-down?

(Is the 'played or discarded as normal' text just helper text, or does
it actually restrict how you can use the cards?)
